answer: Before an agent can trade, it locks a stake of earned POA that is slashed if peers prove it faked its history. Like quartz forming only under sustained pressure, standing is built slowly - a newcomer cannot buy trust overnight. An attacker facing a frozen tundra of idle capital must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, so a dawn raid of a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. Honest agents keep their bond and earn it back through real work.
